From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@acme-fintech.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding & PO process - Redwood Inference / Acme Fintech

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for taking the time earlier today — really appreciate the clear context on the fraud-detection pilot. Quick recap and a few follow-ups so we can align next steps on our side: 

- Decision criteria you mentioned: latency under 200ms p95, maintain current detection precision, and < $0.0008/token for large batch scoring.
- Primary use case: nightly batch scoring + low-latency lookups for triage flows.
- Estimated Q4 pilot scope: 1M transactions/day, spike scaling to 2x during peak.

To keep momentum on the procurement side, could you confirm the following so we can prepare the right paperwork: 
1) Who is the economic buyer / final approver we should engage?
2) Procurement checklist: do you require a vendor onboarding packet (company info, insurance, W-9), security questionnaire, and purchase order (PO) to commit? Any specific templates/process?
3) Invoicing: who handles AP and do you require PO number on invoices?
4) Preferred timeline: you mentioned aiming for pilot kick-off in ~6 weeks — is that still accurate?

Marcus (cc) will own the security questionnaire and can provide our SOC2 summary and security attachments. Once you confirm the items above I’ll assemble the vendor packet and a short mutual action plan for signatures/PO.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none in this message
From: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@acme-fintech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Menon <priya.menon@acme-fintech.com>, Carlos Rivera <c.rivera@acme-fintech.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding & PO process - Redwood Inference / Acme Fintech

Hi Marissa — great summary, thanks. A few answers inline: 

1) Economic buyer: Priya Menon (VP Finance) is the final approver for vendor spend over $50k. Priya (cc) handles finance approvals; Carlos (cc) runs procurement operations and will manage the onboarding checklist.

2) Procurement checklist: yes — we need a vendor onboarding packet (company legal name, address, W-9, insurance cert), a completed vendor information form (PDF), and a standard security questionnaire (we'll send ours if needed). We prefer vendor-provided templates for company info, otherwise we’ll fill with our form.

3) Invoicing: AP requires a PO number on invoices. AP contact is ap@acme-fintech.com (they generate PO once legal signs).

4) Timeline: 4–6 weeks is realistic if onboarding materials are complete. If legal has redlines it can add time — we aim to have the PO issued within 2 weeks after contract signature.

Next steps for us: Carlos will send the vendor information form and security questionnaire this afternoon. Priya wanted to know the all-in pilot pricing and whether a PO can be split for the pilot vs. production (she asked for a short pricing grid).

Thanks — Jordan
